name: ContextFetch
tagline: Web search and any page as LLM-ready Markdown, with only the passages relevant to the query.
description: ContextFetch gives Cline web search and page reading in one call. Results come back as clean Markdown with tables kept, pruned to the passages relevant to the query by a cross-encoder. Tools: search, extract a URL, find similar pages, research (several sub-queries ranked into one evidence pack, quoted verbatim), deep research, extractive answer with citations, crawl a site, map a site's URLs, balance, auto-reload and a free-key tool. Works with no key (25 requests per day per IP); `contextfetch_get_free_key` issues a free key with 2,500 searches.

env.name: CONTEXTFETCH_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key. Leave unset for the free keyless tier (25 requests per day per IP).

install.notes: No key needed to start. Remote alternative: `cline mcp install contextfetch --transport http https://api.contextfetch.dev/mcp` (send a key as the `x-api-key` header).
